buttonMapping.note: all pills: padding 7px 24px, 16/24 MuseoSans 500, radius 100px; groups use .aem-cta-btngroup (flex, gap 12px 24px). Tertiary / inline-block variants are block CSS.

classNaming.rule: canon BEM class names ported to kebab-case: '__' and '--' become '-' (e.g. .chaptertitle__text--center → .chaptertitle-text-center, .aem-main-nav__block--active → .aem-main-nav-block-active). The canon icon font class .icon / .icon--x is .kbc-icon / .kbc-icon-x (EDS owns .icon). Block CSS must lint under stylelint-config-standard (kebab-case selector-class-pattern).

tokens.rule: every var(--x) a block uses must exist here; never redefine a foundation token in block CSS

fonts.file: styles/fonts.css (loaded by loadFonts — eager ≥900px, else in loadLazy)
faces: MuseoSans 300/500/700 woff2 (owner CDN wcmassets.kbc.be, CORS *, never rehosted)

baseType: html 500 100%/1.65 MuseoSans; body color --color-primary-dark on #fff, overflow-x hidden; p 16/24 300; h1–h6, p, ul, ol, figure margin/padding 0; lists unstyled; a = cyan + 1px border-bottom (--color-primary-light-50), plain `a` specificity (not :any-link) so module/block link rules win

breakpoints.note: DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints.target is unset → lint:breakpoints skips; stay on these canon steps (media range syntax: (width <= 991px) / (width >= 992px))

values.landing: home — main is flex column, max-width 1200, margin-top 48 (24 ≤991)
values.article: as listing but flow-root and margin-top 48 (24 ≤991)

templates.sections: main > .section has margin 0 / no max-width: the page rhythm and full-bleed escapes (left: calc(50% - 50vw)) belong to blocks, as in the prototypes. main > .section:empty is hidden.

defaultContent.headings: inside .default-content-wrapper: h1 = alpha (24/28, 30/36 ≥768), h2 = beta (20/28), h3 = gamma (18/24), h4–h6 = delta (16/24); all 700, margin-bottom 24
defaultContent.prose: p / ul / ol margin-bottom 1.65em; li 16/24 300 (14/20 ≤767) with 36px indent (= canon .aem__rich-text); wrapper margin-bottom 24

sectionStyles.center: centred default-content headings and CTA rows
sectionStyles.checkmarks: green checkmark bullets on default-content lists (/icons/checkmark-green.svg)

defaultContent.rule: one style value per section; descendant selectors only (EW2/EW10)

experienceWorkspace: styles.css ships the .prosemirror-editor CTA repaint (strong = sea-blue fill, em = sea-blue outline, strong+em = cyan) and the card-as-link inner-anchor reset

imagePolicy.editorial: upload with da-media-upload.mjs --scope (never media/), author
imagePolicy.decorative: CSS only; fixed brand assets root-relative under /icons/ (kbc-logo.svg, social-*.svg, checkmark-green.svg)
imagePolicy.fallback: captured src first; wcmassets.kbc.be answered 200 to a plain curl for the chrome image

header.roleDetection: section-metadata style (brand | sites | tools | languages | menu | buttons), else by content/order
header.behaviour: desktop: click/Enter toggles mega menus (html.aem-submenu-open, li.aem-main-nav-list-item-active, block.aem-main-nav-block-active), outside click + Escape close; NL dropdown (aria-expanded); ≤991: MENU drawer (html.mobile-navigation-open, scroll lock), drill-down tiles + back, language tile, site-switch tile; body.header-sticky + .brand-row-container-top scroll state ≤991

values.transparent-white: header-transparent header-text-white (default for Template landing — white over the hero)

header.overlay: header stays in flow (--nav-height reserved, transparent ground for the transparent variants); a hero that runs behind it extends upward with its own negative offset (prototype: .introduction-block-home__image-wrapper top -192px, z-index -2) — never give header/main a background
header.fixVsCanon: drawer open: .mobile-navigation-open .brand-row { height: 100% } — the canon kept the 88px row height, which clipped the drawer menu to 0px (the gated prototypes never exercised the open drawer)

footer.block: blocks/footer — DOM = canon footer: footer-full[lead divider, social proof, divider] · footer-grid[doormat] · footer-full[divider] · footer-grid[loan warning, nav.aem-nav-footer(legal ul + sharing)]
footer.roleDetection: section-metadata style (social-proof | doormat | loan-warning | legal | sharing), else by content
footer.social: sharing links get their inline SVG from /icons/social-{facebook|twitter|linkedin}.svg by hostname; link text kept as sr-only label

chromeVariantMechanism.summary: Page metadata only — the archetype units never fork the header/footer: `Template` picks the header ground and the footer document by default, `header-variant` / `footer` override them, `footer-hide` (comma list: lead-divider, social-proof, doormat, loan-warning) or `loan-warning | off` drop footer parts, and `alternate-fr|de|en` + `alternate-<lang>-title` set the language switcher (desktop NL dropdown + mobile language tile) and inject <link rel="alternate" hreflang>.

metadata.alternate-fr-title: Votre pension : planifier, construire et anticiper
metadata.alternate-de-title: Ihre Pension: planen, aufbauen und vorausschauend gestalten
metadata.alternate-en-title: Your pension: planning, building, and looking ahead

chromeVariantMechanism.verify: per-page metadata only applies on the delivered page (the local harness has no pipeline) — check on the preview origin

notInFoundation: breadcrumb (sits between header and main in the listing/program/form prototypes) — page content: author it as the first section/block of those pages
WOW reveal (.animated / fadeIn) — listing block CSS/JS
page grids (.grid-col, col-8 offset-2 …) and per-template CSS

shell.variant: no Template → white interior header + full footer; compare its bands with an interior live page (e.g. /particulieren/nl/betalen/zichtrekeningen.html) or set header-variant on a copy
